channel.title: RangMudra Journal
channel.description: Notes from the RangMudra studio in Bengaluru on block printing, eco printing and caring for hand printed fabric.

item.title: Eco Printing: Process of turning Plants around us into unique Prints
item.description: Pressed leaves, simple bundles, and a steaming pot — discover how the slow art of eco printing can be practised in your kitchen, with results that surprise every time.

item.title: Caring for your block-printed fabric
item.description: Hand-block printed pieces are made to be lived in, washed, and loved — but they ask for gentleness. A short field guide to keeping them beautiful for decades.
